authority_blockers.summary: LAW (dated 'Official version of 13 June 2024') still describes the Commission's Art. 50(7) implementing-act power over codes of practice; AMEND/CONSOLIDATED (in force 2026-07-27) confirm it was removed. LAW is stale relative to the currently governing text.

binding_rules.summary: Providers must ensure direct-interaction AI systems disclose AI nature to natural persons (Art. 50(1)).
Providers of generative AI must mark synthetic audio/image/video/text outputs in machine-readable, detectable form (Art. 50(2)).
Deployers of emotion-recognition/biometric-categorisation systems must inform exposed natural persons (Art. 50(3)).
Deployers must disclose deepfakes and AI-generated public-interest text, subject to editorial-control and artistic-work exemptions (Art. 50(4)).
Required disclosures must be given clearly and at the latest at first interaction/exposure (Art. 50(5)).

guidance_context.summary: FAQ confirms the 2026-08-02/2026-12-02 grace period is scoped to Art. 50(2) marking, not 50(1)/(3)/(4).
FAQ defines the human-review/editorial-control exemption for Art. 50(4) text labeling as requiring deliberate professional review and one accountable publisher, not superficial checks.

timing_rules.summary: Transitional period to 2026-12-02 for the Art. 50(2) marking obligation only, for products already on the EU market before 2026-08-02.
